info.name: Passwords Folders
info.summary: Password manager fork with sharing for whole folders.
Passwort-Manager-Fork, der auch ganze Ordner teilen kann.
info.description:
**This is a fork of the Passwords app that adds sharing for whole folders.** It uses the same database tables as Passwords, so the original app must not be enabled at the same time.
Passwords is the most advanced password manager for Nextcloud and allows you to manage and store your passwords safely in your own cloud. The intuitive and modern web interface of the app makes it easy to update and add new passwords from anywhere. Included security checks help you to keep your online accounts safe and up-to-date. You can also share passwords with other Nextcloud users.
**Features** * Intuitive and modern user interface * Password security monitor * Secure encryption * Folders & tags * Sharing * Dashboard Widget * API for apps * Extensive handbook * Import & Export * Browser extensions & Apps * ... and many more to come
**Support** * [Official Chat](https://matrix.to/#/#nextcloud-passwords:chat.passwordsapp.org) * [Official Forum](https://help.nextcloud.com/tag/passwords-app) * [User Handbook](https://git.mdns.eu/nextcloud-passwords/passwords/-/wikis/Users/Index) * [Administrator Handbook](https://git.mdns.eu/nextcloud-passwords/passwords/-/wikis/Administrators/Index)
**Apps & Extensions** * [Official Firefox Add-On](https://addons.mozilla.org/de/firefox/addon/nextcloud-passwords?utm_source=app&utm_medium=nc-apps) * [Official Chrome Extension](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/nextcloud-passwords/mhajlicjhgoofheldnmollgbgjheenbi) * [Official Microsoft Edge Extension](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/cjmlcljdpphgdfpkngjcmeepdpcgpffk) * [Android App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.jbservices.nc_passwords_app) by [joleaf](https://gitlab.com/joleaf/nc-passwords-app) * [Android App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hegocre.nextcloudpasswords) by [hegocre](https://github.com/hegocre/NextcloudPasswords) * [Windows App (WIP)](https://www.microsoft.com/store/apps/9NXVZ0ZP6D5Z) by [j0chn](https://gitlab.com/j0chn/nextcloud_password_client) * [Windows App](https://github.com/TinyBrickBoy/nextcloud-passworts-desktop) by [TinyBrickBoy](https://github.com/TinyBrickBoy/nextcloud-passworts-desktop/releases/latest) * [Linux App (WIP)](https://gitlab.com/j0chn/nextcloud_password_client/-/tree/main#linux) by [j0chn](https://gitlab.com/j0chn/nextcloud_password_client) * [Linux App](https://github.com/TinyBrickBoy/nextcloud-passworts-desktop) by [TinyBrickBoy](https://github.com/TinyBrickBoy/nextcloud-passworts-desktop/releases/latest) * [macOS App (WIP)](https://gitlab.com/j0chn/nextcloud_password_client/-/tree/main#mac-os) by [j0chn](https://gitlab.com/j0chn/nextcloud_password_client) * [iOS App](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1546212226) by [Johannes Schliephake](https://github.com/johannes-schliephake/nextcloud-passwords-ios)

Passwords ist der beste Passwort-Manager für Nextcloud und ermöglicht es Ihnen, Ihre Passwörter sicher und einfach in Ihrer eigenen Cloud zu verwalten. Die intuitive Weboberfläche macht es einfach Passwörter von überall aus hinzuzufügen oder zu aktualisieren. Dank des eingebauten Sicherheitstests können Sie Ihre Benutzerkonten sicher und Ihre Passwörter aktuell halten. Sie können auch einzelne Passwörter mit anderen Nutzern teilen.
**Funktionsumfang** * Intuitive und moderne Weboberfläche * Passwortsicherheitsüberwachung * Sichere Verschlüsselung * Ordner & Tags * Teilen-Funktion * Dashboard Widget * Umfangreiche API * Import & Export * Detailliertes Handbuch * Browser Extensions & Apps * ... und vieles mehr
